primitive.$description: Yaobet overlay, primitive tier. Exactly one new hex, allowed by D-DS5 (the single exception to D-DS2). Nothing else in this overlay is a literal.

300.$description: D-DS5 loss red. Same hue as red.400 (#EF7B71, 4.8 deg, saturation 0.79), lighter step, so it sits above 400 in the ramp. Relative luminance 0.426 vs green.400 0.425: 0.2% apart (TOKENS.md rule 4.1, <= 5%). Contrast: 7.88 page, 7.17 surface.1, 6.47 surface.2, 5.68 surface.3, 6.98 on feedback.tint.danger. 1.23 against red.400, so loss and validation-red differ in lightness, not in hue.

semantic.$description: Yaobet overlay, semantic tier (approved 2026-11-07, D-DS6). Merged over the delivered DS: a path that already exists is re-pointed, a new path is added. Every $value is a {ref} to a token that exists in docs/design/wine-gold/*.json or earlier in this overlay. The only new hex is primitive.color.red.300 (D-DS5). Contrast = WCAG 2 ratio computed from the resolved primitives.

muted-raised.$description: Fixes review defect 1 (High). Muted text on surface.3 (modal, toast, tooltip) and wine surfaces. text.muted (neutral.400) measures 4.11 on surface.3 and 4.25 on wine.panel. neutral.300: 5.83 on surface.3, 6.03 on wine.panel, 6.90 on wine.header, 7.73 on wine.deep, 7.36 on surface.1.

loss.$description: Fixes defect 3 (High), D-DS5. Re-points DS feedback.loss (was feedback.danger = red.400: L 0.337 vs win 0.425, 20.8% apart, loss quieter). red.300 L 0.426, 0.2% from green.400, so a loss is exactly as loud as a win. Contrast: 7.88 page, 7.17 surface.1, 6.47 surface.2, 5.68 surface.3. feedback.danger stays red.400 for validation and destructive actions.

paused.$description: Fixes defect 5 (High). The 'tam dung' status foreground, distinct from danger and from loss. neutral.300: 5.66 on feedback.tint.paused, 5.83 on surface.3, 8.08 on page.
Fixes defect 5 (High). Paused pill fill. Pill vs page 1.43 (decorative fill; the label carries the state, never the fill alone). Text on it: feedback.paused 5.66.

text.$description: Restores the pruned action.secondary.text (defect 4). gold.300 label on the transparent secondary button: 10.71 page, 9.75 surface.1, 8.80 surface.2, 7.99 wine.panel. Gold as text and line, never a fill (TOKENS.md 4.2).

5.$description: Defect 6: replaces --space-5 (24px, unchanged; note TOKENS.md 3.5 lists space-5 as 20, the repo value is 24).

6.$description: Defect 6: replaces --space-6 (32px, unchanged). Also absorbs --space-7 (40px, off the DS scale, 3 call sites).

gutter.$description: Defect 6: page horizontal gutter, replaces --gutter (16px, unchanged).

sm.$description: Defect 6: chip rows and dense tile clusters, replaces --gap-sm (8px).

md.$description: Defect 6: grid and rail gap, replaces --gap (16px).

band.$description: Defect 6: gap between home bands, replaces --band-gap (16px, kept: it was the dead-space fix). Owner may move it to scale.32 (TOKENS.md 3.5 --space-section).

field.$description: Defect 6: vertical rhythm between form fields, replaces --field-rhythm (24px).

gap.$description: Defect 10: minimum gap between adjacent touch targets (TOKENS.md 3.11 --size-hit-gap 8px).

lg.$description: Defect 10: icon size large (TOKENS.md 3.11, 24px). Icon md (20px) has no DS primitive and stays absent (overlay approved without it, D-DS6).

strong.$description: Defect 10. The repo reads --weight-bold (700) at 128 call sites and one literal 800 (typography.css .u-label), but D-DS3 loads 400/500/600 only, so a 700 token would render as synthesized bold. Strong emphasis maps to 600.

family.$description: Defect 6: role ramp. Playfair Display, hero only.

leading.$description: 1.3, not the DS leading.display 1.25: Vietnamese stacked marks need >= 1.3 on text >= 20px (multi-line hero copy).

weight.$description: 600: thicker hairlines keep stacked marks legible in the high-contrast serif.

family.$description: Playfair Display; smallest serif step (26px at 375).
Defect 13 (Medium): Be Vietnam Pro, not Playfair, below 26px so stacked marks do not thin out.

leading.$description: 1.6: running text at 14px keeps full diacritic headroom.

size.$description: 28-36px fluid; hero balance and hero money.

leading.$description: 1.25: allowed only because numerals are single-line and carry no diacritics.

family.$description: Inter, tabular; inline money and odds.

surface.$description: Defect 6 and 12: cards, sheets, modals, tiles (8px; absorbs the repo's 12px and 16px).

pill.$description: Defect 6: pills, avatars, the bottom-bar centre button (999px).

base.$description: Defect 6: 250ms reveals, tab change, sheet enter.

ambient.$description: Defect 6: 650ms skeleton shimmer and the single home ambient loop; static under reduced motion.

surface.$description: Restores pruned elevation.level.1.surface (defect 6): the fill that pairs with level.1.shadow (cards). Card title on it 13.80, meta 7.36.

component.$description: Yaobet overlay, component tier. Each entry resolves to a semantic token. Restores the pruned tokens listed in _removed-orphans.json that Yaobet components consume, and fixes the modal/toast/tooltip edge.

The knob never sits on checked.bg (gold.300 on gold.500 is 1.29).

active.$description: Defect 4. Active tab label in gold (active nav is a TOKENS.md 4.2 gold use): 10.71 page, 9.75 surface.1. Paired with tab.indicator, so state is not colour alone.

up.$description: Defect 4. Odds rising, green.400: 6.46 on odds.bg (surface.2), 5.67 on odds.selected.bg (surface.3). Pair with an up arrow, never colour alone.
